coordinates.sourceToApp: Identity native source positions. Whole pre-existing left connected components extracted; no registration or mirroring.

modifications: Extracted complete original disconnected left components. Every referenced position, normal, UV and material value is unchanged. Source triangle corners are retained with compact local index remapping; source image bytes are embedded unchanged. Original right components and current-body right IDs remain untouched.
limitations: This educational composition adds eleven intact original left bone components. It is not a complete left skeleton, limb, head/neck or measured whole-human atlas.
No mirroring, coordinate transform, triangle slicing, source anatomical deformation or new inferred bone surface is used. Original right physical IDs and raw datasets remain untouched.

The retained rib interfaces are not collision-free: original posterior muscle attachment and cartilage/joint surface overlaps remain. The largest retained sampled muscle-to-bone overlap is 3.052447 mm at second rib / levatores costarum breves.

The existing Z diaphragm contacts ribs 9–12 at costal/posterior attachment regions. Sampled depths are respectively 0.999602, 1.426751, 0.519560 and 2.192070 mm. Original Z rib comparisons already have related residuals of 1.487783, 1.919304, 0.940294 and 1.889180 mm; shared ancestry does not establish exact interface registration.

These are accepted as disclosed bounded source-model attachment residuals for gross educational viewing, not as measured entheses, physiological tissue fusion, clinical segmentation or exact layer separation.
Clavicle, hip, first/fifth/sixth ribs remain held. Ribs as a canonical group must stay partial; only available numbered source bones are represented.
The source Humerus and Scapula components establish intact left bones and their original shared frame only. Left forearm/hand and shoulder soft-tissue completion is not inferred.
Triangle crossing counts and finite contained vertex/centroid depth samples are reproducible diagnostics, not continuous volume overlap or global Hausdorff bounds.

Some original retained Right-labelled muscle and vein nodes contain both sides. Source names and physical extent are distinct; new left bone names are independently supported by complete positive-X source components.
Original material, normal, UV and resolved texture/image values are preserved. Mixed original licensing and attribution notices are included; no new licence is granted.
